Ruth (People Ops): Quick drop: made a tiny 'Keep / Grow / Stretch' goal framing + 2-line self-review elevator pitch. Designed to help managers calibrate across levels without long writeups. Paste-friendly. :sparkles:
Ethan (Staff Eng): curious  how does "Grow" differ from "Stretch"?
Ruth (People Ops): short defs: Keep = maintain or incremental improvements; Grow = expand scope or skills (lateral growth, ~20-50% harder); Stretch = bigger bet, scope or impact jump (>50% or uncapped). Use these tags to normalize expectations across teams.
Maya (SWE): can you give a one-line example for each so I can paste into my 1:1 agenda?
Ruth (People Ops): sure. Examples: Keep: "Keep: Reduce flaky test failures by 30% (CI flake rate 12% -> 8%)." Grow: "Grow: Lead cross-team rollout of feature flags for checkout (reduce delayed launches by X%)." Stretch: "Stretch: Launch experimental checkout redesign pilot to 5% of traffic and measure conversion delta >= 2pp."
CalBot: reminder  calibration window starts in 10 days. recommend managers ask for self-reviews 7 days prior. (auto)
Ethan (Staff Eng): nice. what's the self-review elevator pitch you mentioned? needs to fit a PR description
Ruth (People Ops): two-line self-review elevator: Line 1 = Outcome + tag (Keep/Grow/Stretch) + metric delta. Line 2 = Evidence (links) + one-sentence learning or next-step. e.g., "Outcome (Grow): reduced rollout time for feature flags by 40% (2d -> 1.2d). Evidence: PRs, dashboard link. Learning: invest earlier in schema contracts."
Maya (SWE): can managers get a one-line calibration note to paste into the calibration doc? we always spend 10 minutes writing the same sentence
Ruth (People Ops): Manager one-line calibration note (paste-ready): "Candidate: <IC name> | Tag: Keep/Grow/Stretch | Confidence: high/med/low | Evidence: <link> | Risk: <brief>". keeps calibration rows compact.
Ethan (Staff Eng): can we add a quick peer-review one-liner for async feedback?
Ruth (People Ops): Peer one-liner: "Observed: <impact/behavior>. Evidence: <link>. Development suggestion: <one short step>."
Maya (SWE): love the brevity. any suggested cadence for managers to nudge ICs about tags?
Ruth (People Ops): tip: when you set quarterly goals, ask the IC to propose a tag (Keep/Grow/Stretch) and a short rationale. Managers confirm or re-tag during the 1:1 within 2 weeks. This pre-aligns calibration expectations.
CalBot: note  new template uploaded to goals hub: "Keep-Grow-Stretch cheat" (auto-entry)
